cause: Projection validation treated nested current-agent authority as advisory after validating the outer projection, so structurally incomplete or contradictory nested identity could still acknowledge a committed claim revision.
prevention: Require the canonical active claim status, non-empty present optional identities, and exact current-agent claim_path and status before acknowledging progress; lock every recurrence case in orchestrator atomic-write regressions.
summary: The first projection-binding mitigation constrained outer receipt and pointer fields but a later independent review reproduced acceptance of missing or conflicting current-agent claim_path and status plus present-empty optional unit and task-set identities.
title: Bind current-agent projection to canonical claim authority
